A few quick choices, one at a time. I’ll only show what may be useful, and you can change everything later.
Skip whenever you want. Everything stays on your phone: no account, no diagnosis, nothing sent elsewhere.

How do you want time to work?
You can change this before every session. After 3 completions, the app can suggest a local reference based on your longest active duration, rounded up plus one minute. Never forced.
